Beta SaaS Corp Q2 2026 Earnings Call

Operator: Good morning and welcome to the Beta SaaS Corp second quarter 2026 earnings call.

Priya Nair — Chief Executive Officer: Thank you all for joining. Annual recurring revenue grew to $85 million, up from $70 million a year ago. Net revenue retention was 118% this quarter.

Tom Yu — Chief Financial Officer: Gross margin was 72%, and we are guiding full-year annual recurring revenue to approximately $340 million.

Operator: We will now begin the question-and-answer session.

Analyst One: Can you comment on churn trends this quarter?

Priya Nair: Churn rate remained low at 4% annually, consistent with the prior two quarters.
